scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @hazcom/windows && npm run build -w @hazcom/mobile
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:sqlite
scripts.test:firebase: cd firebase && npx -y firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --project demo-hazcom-navigator --only auth,firestore,storage "npm --prefix functions test"
scripts.firebase:deploy: cd firebase && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --project hazcom-navigator-dev
scripts.firebase:deploy:firestore: cd firebase && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only firestore --project hazcom-navigator-dev
